name: Cord blood banking
summary: How expats weigh private cord blood banking in Singapore — evidence limits, contract fine print, and public donation alternatives versus sales pressure in late pregnancy.
body:
Private cord blood banks market future stem-cell possibilities. Medical societies generally urge caution on routine private banking for healthy families; public donation pathways exist where available. Sales often peak at antenatal expos.

## Questions to force early
- What conditions have proven autologous uses vs speculative lists
- Collection success rates and contingency if volume is low
- Storage term, relocation shipping if you leave Singapore
- Annual fees after the initial package
- Consent timing with obstetric teams on delivery day

Do not let a bank representative replace a conversation with your OB.

## How to choose
Prefer transparent contracts, clear exit/relocation clauses, and no same-day deposit pressure. Compare public donation eligibility if altruism is the goal. Budget opportunity cost against emergency funds and insurance deductibles.

## Practical tip
If you proceed, put collection kit instructions in the hospital bag and tell the labour team early — last-minute scrambling misses collection windows.
